title: Functions
description: Small handlers that cost nothing while idle. A function sleeps after a quiet period and the next request wakes it and waits for the answer.

webhook.title: Signed webhook
webhook.on: Calls are queued and forwarded to {{path}}. Signatures older than {{seconds}} seconds are rejected.
webhook.secretOnce: Signing secret. It is shown once, copy it now.
webhook.signing: Send X-Signature-Timestamp (unix seconds) and X-Signature: sha256=HMAC-SHA256(secret, timestamp + dot + body).

schedules.title: Schedules
schedules.none: No scheduled HTTP jobs call this function.
schedules.manage: Manage schedules in the Jobs tab of the app

dead.title: Dead letters
dead.description: Async calls that ran out of retries. Retry puts one back in the queue.
dead.error: Dead letters could not be loaded: {{message}}

empty.title: No functions yet
empty.body: Pick a runtime below, push the handler to a repository and deploy it. It gets a live URL that wakes on request.

deploy.description: Pick what to run, point at the code, and go live. Each step has a sensible default.
deploy.started: Build started for {{name}}. It goes live when the build finishes.

repo.title: Use my own repository
repo.body: Deploy a handler you already have in git.

image.title: Use a container image
image.body: Run a prebuilt image from a registry.

source.starterBody: Copy these files into a new repository and push it. Then pick that repository below.
source.utilityBody: A complete, tested handler. Copy the files into a new repository and push it, then pick that repository below.
source.utilityKv: Uses the key-value store: after deploying, open the function's Key-value store tab and enable it.
source.noRepos: No repositories found. Connect a git provider in Settings, or paste a URL instead.
source.refHint: Defaults to the repository's main branch.
source.directoryHint: Leave empty when the handler is at the repository root.
source.imageHint: Include a tag such as :1.0. Without one the latest tag is used.

details.name: Name
details.nameHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes. It becomes part of the URL.
details.idleHint: A quiet function sleeps to save resources. The next request wakes it, which adds a short delay called a cold start.
details.routeHint: Also answer at one of your domains, for example example.com/hello.
details.portHint: The port your handler listens on. It receives it as the PORT variable.

summary.title: Ready to deploy
summary.text: This will {{build}}, sleep after {{sleep}}, and be reachable at {{url}}.
summary.urlPending: a URL assigned when the build finishes

result.title: Deploying {{name}}
result.building: Building and starting your function. This usually takes a minute or two.
result.failed: The build failed. Open the function to read the build log.
result.waitingUrl: The URL appears here as soon as it is ready.

validation.repoRequired: Choose a repository or paste its URL.
validation.repoInvalid: Enter a full URL that starts with https://.
validation.nameInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and dashes, starting and ending with a letter or number.
validation.nameTooLong: Keep the name short enough to fit in a URL.
validation.nameTaken: That name is already used by another app. Pick a different one.
validation.idleInvalid: Enter a whole number of minutes, at least the minimum allowed.
validation.domainRequired: Choose a domain for the path.
validation.pathInvalid: Use a path such as /hello with letters, numbers, dashes or dots.

deploy.name: Name
deploy.directoryHint: Leave empty when the handler is at the repository root.
deploy.routeHint: Optional. A domain already attached to an app, plus a path such as /hello, serves this function at domain/hello. The prefix is stripped before the request reaches the handler.

templates.title: Starter handlers
templates.description: Each starter is a complete handler of about ten lines. Railpack builds it without a Dockerfile and it listens on the PORT variable.
templates.error: Starter handlers could not be loaded: {{message}}

kv.error: Could not load the key-value store: {{message}}
kv.disabled: The store is off for this function. Enable it to give the function KV_URL and KV_TOKEN; it restarts with them.
kv.tokenIssued: Token issued. The function restarts with the new KV_TOKEN.
kv.deleteBody: The function loses this value immediately.

detail.notFound: This function was not found. It may have been deleted or stopped sleeping.

settings.limitsHelp: Apply while a request waits for a sleeping function to start. 0 uses the server default. A request over the concurrency limit gets a 429 with Retry-After.
settings.timeoutHelp: Longest wait for a cold start, at most {{max}} s. Now {{effective}} s (0 means the adaptive default).
settings.concurrencyHelp: Requests held at once, at most {{max}}. Now {{effective}} (0 means no limit).

versions.title: Versions
versions.help: Roll back to an earlier deploy, or pin it: pinning rolls back and locks publishing so new builds stay held until you unlock.

observe.title: Calls and test console
observe.emptyBody: Calls appear here while the control plane keeps them in memory. Send one from the test console.
observe.captureLabel: Keep the input of test calls so they can be replayed
observe.captureHint: Off by default. Only calls sent from the test console or the CLI are kept, never other traffic. Credential headers are dropped.

console.wakeHint: If the function is asleep this waits for it to wake first.
console.truncated: The body was cut at the size limit.

banner.title: Functions
banner.description: Small handlers that cost nothing while idle. They sleep after a quiet period and wake on the next request.
